timing_contract: Parse native numeric rows only; no smoothing, imputation or log-based target exclusion. All temperatures/rates in each Test ID stay together.
calibration: T_K is absolute temperature in kelvin; eta is cP. The factor1000 carries kelvin, so9 is dimensionless and represents an effective activation scale9000K. Formulation amplitudes a_f range52.1603–218.5126cP at333.15K; all ten exact values are in rules.json. A shear-rate input is allowed for competitors, but the selected thermal reference does not use it.
independent_unit: whole Test ID; synthesis lots not identified

challenger.equation: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the yield branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.

baseline_mean.equation: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the mean branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.

baseline_rbf.equation: Frozen Gaussian-kernel ridge: baseline(if residual)+intercept+sum_j w_j exp(-||train-standardized X-center_j||^2/(2 width^2)); all input scaling, categorical encoding, center arrays, coefficients, ridge and optional baseline state in rules.json.

baseline_residual_rbf.equation: Frozen Gaussian-kernel ridge: baseline(if residual)+intercept+sum_j w_j exp(-||train-standardized X-center_j||^2/(2 width^2)); all input scaling, categorical encoding, center arrays, coefficients, ridge and optional baseline state in rules.json.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Shared conditions, sensor/system dependence or small numbers of reserved groups do not support precise population-level confidence. No row-bootstrap intervals.

scope_limits: Repeated tests of ten already calibrated formulations in one rheometer dataset; no independent synthesis-lot or unseen-loading transfer.

exposure.historical_record: All packaged targets are now exposed; future scoring is retrospective. One inspected file with first low-temperature responses was excluded from the reserved pool. Target-independent metadata hash chooses one complete test per formulation; no confirmation score was opened.

historical_metric_corrections: F1 uses2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero on nonempty total failure. Historical reports unchanged.
